name: Cape Cod Zen Center
reason: Too thin: its own site (capecodzen.com -> www.capecodzen.com, GoDaddy builder; robots.txt * group allows pages but disallows /images/) has four short pages: two weekly sittings (Monday at the Unitarian Church of Barnstable, Thursday at the centre in Barnstable; $5.00 donation requested), monthly interviews and talks with guiding teacher Terry Cronin JDPSN, and one one-day retreat on 14 Nov 2026 sold through Eventbrite. No videos, no other offerings, generic welcome text, images on nebula.wsimg.com not checked. Email info@capecodzen.com was published. Founded by Jim Calvin and Tim Woolard; joined the Kwan Um School in 2003. Owner may prefer to keep it like Cochise (kept with three free items).
